main_result.protocol: official 10,000-episode population (50 tasks x 100 expert-accepted seeds from 100000, demo_clean with seen and demo_randomized with unseen instructions), replayed with fixed cached goals

evidence_status: Recorded benchmark result, reproduced end to end. The checkpoint is published at Hugging Face revision 167dcd0a19e8. Rerunning all 10,000 cases in the RoboTwin simulator through the XPolicyLab adapter with the released code and checkpoint matched the recorded run on every case: per-case success agrees on 10,000 / 10,000 and the executed joint commands are bitwise identical (85,058 queries).
disclosures: Goal images were generated by an external image model from the initial head-camera image and the instruction only.
Cached goals were visually reviewed; 9,974 passed and 26 were accepted by the authors after a failed or uncertain review.
The post-training recipe's offline evaluation (no gradient) read 4 demo_randomized episodes per task.
The submitted iteration was selected among checkpoints evaluated on the same benchmark population.
